itens.titulo: Nvidia and Micron are part of Zacks Earnings Preview
itens.descricao: Nvidia and Micron are part of Zacks Earnings Preview Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: For Immediate Release Chicago, IL – September 21, 2026 – Zacks.com releases the list of companies likely to issue earnings surprises.
Q3 Earnings Season Preview: What Can Investors Expect?
The overall setup remains very favorable as we start looking ahead to the Q3 earnings season.
S&P 500 earnings are expected to increase by +24% from the same period last year, the 8th straight quarter of double-digit earnings growth for the index.
The Tech sector remains a major growth contributor, but momentum is broad-based, with 14 of the 16 Zacks sectors on track to enjoy positive earnings growth in Q3.

However, for Q3 2026, the constructive estimate revisions have broadened significantly, rising across 8 of the 16 Zacks sectors—including Transportation, Finance, Aerospace, Industrials, Utilities, and Autos alongside Tech and Energy.

On the negative side, Q3 estimates have been under pressure for these 8 sectors since the quarter got underway – Conglomerates, Basic Materials, Consumer Staples, Consumer Discretionary, Medical, Business Services, Retail, and Construction.
Sector Focus: Broad-Based Strength Q3 earnings are expected to be above the year-earlier level for 14 of the 16 Zacks sectors, with 5 sectors expected to enjoy double-digit growth.

itens.titulo: MicroStrategy Ends Two-Week Pause With 950 Bitcoin: Is the Buying Engine Stalling?
itens.descricao: MicroStrategy Ends Two-Week Pause With 950 Bitcoin: Is the Buying Engine Stalling? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, added 950 Bitcoin (BTC) in the week to September 20 and repurchased $174 million of its own preferred stock over the same stretch.
Total holdings now sit at 846,000 BTC.
At the $81,200 bitcoin price Strategy used in Monday's filing, the 950 coins are worth roughly $77 million.

How the MicroStrategy Bitcoin Purchase Compares With August The company's previous acquisition landed on August 31, when it ended a 10-week pause with 4,603 BTC bought for $369.7 million at an average of $80,318 a coin.
In dollar terms, last week's purchase is about 79% smaller.
Executive Chairman Michael Saylor teased the buy on Sunday with a post reading "A little more orange." Bitcoin has since climbed above the level Strategy used in its own math.
The asset traded near $85,020 on Monday, up almost 6% over 24 hours.

Why the Preferred Buyback Cost More Than the Bitcoin The $174 million went to Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC), a Nasdaq-listed share class Strategy designed to trade close to $100.

itens.titulo: Economistas veem mais corte na Selic e inflação mais alta; confira o Focus desta segunda-feira (21)
itens.descricao: Economistas veem mais corte na Selic e inflação mais alta; confira o Focus desta segunda-feira (21) Money Times
itens.texto:
Economistas veem mais corte na Selic e inflação mais alta; confira o Focus desta segunda-feira (21)
Os economistas ouvidos pelo Banco Central (BC) reduziram as expectativas para a Selic e aumentaram a da inflação em 2026, mostrou o Relatório Focus divulgado nesta segunda-feira (21).
A mediana do mercado caiu de 13,75% para 13,50% ao ano, interrompendo a estabilidade observada no levantamento anterior e indicando expectativa de juros um pouco menores no encerramento do ano.
O ajuste vem após a decisão do Comitê de Política Monetária (Copom) que reduziu a taxa de juros para 13,75% na semana passada. Nesta terça-feira (22), o mercado recebe ainda a ata da decisão para calibrar as expectativas futuras da política monetária.
Ao mesmo tempo, a projeção para o IPCA de 2026 subiu de 4,90% para 4,92%, em alta na semana. Apesar do avanço, a estimativa segue abaixo de 5%, nível que aparecia no levantamento de quatro semanas antes, quando a mediana estava em 5,02%. Para 2027, a expectativa de inflação permaneceu em 4,30%, enquanto as projeções para 2028 e 2029 ficaram estáveis em 3,80% e 3,50%, respectivamente.
No crescimento econômico, o mercado voltou a reduzir as estimativas para o PIB. A projeção para 2026 caiu de 1,89% para 1,88%, em baixa pela segunda semana seguida. Para 2027, a mediana também recuou, de 1,45% para 1,43%, igualmente pelo segundo levantamento consecutivo. Já as expectativas para 2028 e 2029 ficaram estáveis, em 1,87% e 2,00%.
As estimativas para o câmbio tiveram pouca alteração. Para o fim de 2026, a projeção permaneceu em R$ 5,20 por dólar, mantendo estabilidade prolongada. As medianas para 2027, 2028 e 2029 também não mudaram na comparação semanal, em R$ 5,28, R$ 5,30 e R$ 5,36, respectivamente.

itens.titulo: Chevron (CVX) Supercharges its Venezuela Bet with More Oil Rigs
itens.descricao: Chevron (CVX) Supercharges its Venezuela Bet with More Oil Rigs Yahoo Finance
trechos: The company's CFO, Eimear Bonner, revealed at a Barclays conference on September 8 that the American oil giant plans to more than double the number of oil rigs it operates in the country as part of its five-year plan to increase output.

The statement follows the company's recent announcement that its joint venture partnerships in Venezuela would invest more than $7 billion to more than double oil output to 600,000 barrels per day by 2031.
The current production from Chevron's three Venezuelan JVs totals around 290,000, which is all exported to the United States.
The expansion comes alongside a much larger agreement between Washington and Caracas announced this month, which gave the US majority control over around 20% of Venezuela's proven crude reserves.
A Low-Cost Growth Opportunity: Chevron has maintained operations in Venezuela since 1923 and even stayed through the nationalizations that forced ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips to exit in 2007.
The 600,000 bpd of output will contribute significantly to its earnings and cash flows.
The economics of the project also appear attractive, as the oil major expects to keep total production costs to below $20 per barrel.
